sources.title: Pentagon says Trump ordered Washington military parade

supported_event_claim: The White House confirmed that Trump asked the Pentagon to plan a military parade in Washington.
reason: AP reported the White House confirmation of a military parade planning request.

sources.title: Trump claims 'total' authority, over govs, to reopen economy

supported_event_claim: Trump said he had total authority over decisions to reopen the economy during COVID-19 restrictions.
reason: AP directly reported his public assertion and governors' disagreement.

sources.title: Trump suggests US slow virus testing to avoid bad statistics

supported_event_claim: At a Tulsa rally Trump said he asked his administration to slow coronavirus testing.
reason: AP directly reported the remark; it does not establish that testing actually was slowed.

sources.title: Office of Management and Budget—Withholding of Ukraine Security Assistance

supported_event_claim: GAO concluded that OMB's withholding of Ukraine security assistance violated the Impoundment Control Act.
reason: GAO's original legal decision supports the conclusion, but it was issued January 16, 2020, not the catalogue's December 22, 2019.

sources.title: CDC Statement on Testing Guidance
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

supported_event_claim: CDC confirmed it had updated its guidance on COVID-19 testing of people without symptoms after exposure.
reason: CDC's original August 26 statement directly acknowledges the updated guidance; it does not prove the catalogue's August 24 date.

sources.title: Trump Signs Law Establishing U.S. Space Force

supported_event_claim: Trump signed the fiscal-year 2020 National Defense Authorization Act establishing the U.S. Space Force.
reason: The Defense Department directly describes the signing and creation of the military service.

sources.title: Proclamation on Suspension of Entry of Persons Who Pose a Risk of Transmitting 2019 Novel Coronavirus

supported_event_claim: Trump proclaimed restrictions on entry by certain noncitizens who had recently been in China.
reason: The dated presidential proclamation states the restrictions and exceptions.

sources.title: Proclamation on Suspension of Entry of Certain Additional Persons Who Pose a Risk of Transmitting Coronavirus

supported_event_claim: Trump issued COVID-19 entry restrictions covering certain noncitizens recently present in Iran.
reason: The presidential proclamation specifically adds Iran to the entry restrictions.

sources.title: Proclamation—Suspension of Entry of Certain Additional Persons Who Pose a Risk of Transmitting 2019 Novel Coronavirus

supported_event_claim: Trump issued COVID-19-related entry restrictions concerning the Schengen Area.
reason: The original presidential proclamation describes the Schengen Area restriction.

sources.title: Proclamation on the Suspension of Entry of Certain Additional Persons Who Pose a Risk of Transmitting Coronavirus

supported_event_claim: Trump extended COVID-19-related travel restrictions to cover recent travel from the United Kingdom and Ireland.
reason: The presidential proclamation specifically covers the United Kingdom and Ireland.

sources.title: Proclamation on Suspension of Entry of Certain Additional Persons Who Pose a Risk of Transmitting Novel Coronavirus

supported_event_claim: Trump proclaimed COVID-19 entry restrictions for certain noncitizens recently present in Brazil.
reason: The signed presidential proclamation identifies Brazil and the entry limitation.

sources.title: Statement from Attorney General James on Criminal Indictment of Trump Organization and CFO Weisselberg

supported_event_claim: The Trump Organization's corporate entities and CFO Allen Weisselberg were indicted on criminal tax-related charges.
reason: The state attorney general's original announcement identifies the defendants and distinguishes allegations from findings of guilt.

sources.title: Statement from Attorney General James on Guilty Plea of Trump Organization CFO Weisselberg

supported_event_claim: Allen Weisselberg pleaded guilty in a tax scheme involving compensation received through the Trump Organization.
reason: The attorney general's statement announces the guilty plea; it supports the plea, not guilt by other individuals.

sources.title: D.A. Bragg: Allen Weisselberg Sentenced to 5 Months in Jail

supported_event_claim: Allen Weisselberg was sentenced to five months in jail in the Trump Organization tax case.
reason: The Manhattan district attorney's sentencing announcement directly reports the disposition.
